name: Bornean Sun Bear Conservation Centre
summary: Rescue, care for and rehabilitate sun bears in Sabah, release suitable bears back to the wild, and raise awareness of the world's smallest bear.
programmes: Rescue and rehabilitation of confiscated or orphaned sun bears
Permanent sanctuary for bears that cannot be released
Release and monitoring (Tabin Sun Bear Project)
Research on sun bear biology, health and behaviour
impact: 43 rescued sun bears in care, 13 hard-released to date (The Star, July 2026)
15 bears rescued between 2018 and 2026 (The Star, July 2026)
beneficiaries: Rescued and ex-captive Bornean sun bears; visitors and schools in Sabah

organisation.founders: Dr. (Hons) Wong Siew Te, listed as CEO and founder; founding partners named as Sabah Forestry Department, Sabah Wildlife Department and Land Empowerment Animals People (LEAP)
organisation.leadership: Dr. (Hons) Wong Siew Te, CEO and Founder
